lines.text: Could you hold one price for 70 years? Coca-Cola did. A Coke cost 5 cents through two world wars. Why couldn't it rise?

lines.text: So why not just charge more?
Coke tied its brand to five cents, and its vending machines took a single nickel. The next coin up was a dime, double the price.
